purpose: Authorize a sixth future-only 32-image image-bound v3 E2 lineage using deterministic stable identifier ordering from the remaining rebuilt prescreen-v2 pool.

evidence.fifth_result: 80 parent and 80 audit outcomes were delivered in R0; R1/R2 were explicit zero-request closures; collection closed at 29 selected and three confirmed quality rejects.
evidence.negative_sampling_result: Descending OOF top-1 confidence did not improve collection qualification: one reject had score 0.918, so confidence is not treated as a sufficient collection-quality proxy.
evidence.remaining_pool: 160 candidates, 20 per fixed cell, after excluding eleven source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identity.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Select four fresh identities per fixed cell by stable sample ID order, excluding all eleven preceding source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identities.

qualification: This future-only sampling arm does not relax the exact 32-row/four-per-cell requirement. Confirmed quality rejections remain terminal and SFT remains separately unauthorized.
